slices.intention: guard typed event send and consumption through persisted owned event state

compatibilityRisks: A stale, canceled, consumed, or cross-owner event reaches the component
Duplicate sends or consumes change terminal state
An explicit error is confused with a typed value
existingModuleRepairChecklist.promptVersioningImpact: Owned event selector, generated definition, delivery kind, and lifecycle transition are versioned inputs.

workPackages.target: WP-1.4 authenticated internal typed event send
workPackages.templateResolutionPath: Resolve only an active persisted owned ID or generated definition selector, derive tenant ownership, authenticate, send through the component ID, and record one delivery/consumption transition.

slices.rationale: Component event delivery must be preceded by opaque application ownership and lifecycle checks.

slices.intention: generate shared typed event definitions and identity-free public translators

compatibilityRisks: A public caller supplies workspace, principal, generation, or a raw component event name
Generated payload validation diverges from the awaited validator
Old string-event runners are silently rewritten
existingModuleRepairChecklist.promptVersioningImpact: Generated event reference, validator, schema name, registry, and public selector key are immutable workflow source.

slices.rationale: Every new workflow needs one generated typed definition and safe public translation path by default.

slices.intention: publish terminal event evidence and request only proven semantic promotions

compatibilityRisks: A semantic status is promoted without compiler, runtime, and generator evidence
Consumption masks an explicit event error or cancellation
existingModuleRepairChecklist.promptVersioningImpact: Consumption step name and semantic evidence remain stable across replay.

workPackages.target: WP-1.4 terminal typed event semantic evidence
workPackages.templateResolutionPath: Publish compiler/runtime/generator fixtures and submit the exact semantic-ledger promotion to its owner without editing that authority in this lane.

slices.rationale: Semantic support claims follow executable evidence and preserve the Agent-A authority boundary.
